hero.title: Free tech courses with *Kursuok.lt*
hero.subtitle: Through Kursuok.lt, the state covers up to €500 of training – the full price of a Unicamp program. With funding, you learn frontend development or UX/UI design without paying anything.
hero.status: Next call expected in late autumn 2026
hero.ctaCaption: We'll let you know as soon as registration opens

eligibility.title: Who can get *funding*
eligibility.description: These were the conditions of the latest call (November 2025). Kursuok.lt will publish the conditions of the next one.
items: You're employed – on an employment contract or equivalent, or self-employed
You're a Lithuanian citizen or hold a Lithuanian residence permit
You have a vocational or higher education qualification
You haven't used up your full €500 Kursuok.lt budget yet

priority.title: Who gets priority
priority.description: If more people apply than there is funding, a queue is formed. Priority goes to people:
items: with an assessed participation level of 55% or lower
living outside Vilnius, Kaunas, Klaipėda and Šiauliai
who got their education 10 or more years ago
in older age groups – starting with 50–65

eligibility.source: Source: Ministry of Education, Science and Sport, 2025-11-27

steps.title: Step by step
items: Save your spot with Unicamp – we'll tell you when registration opens
Sign in to Kursuok.lt through the e-government gateway – it checks your eligibility automatically
Choose a Unicamp program and submit your application
Once funded, you start learning – and pay nothing for the course

faqs.title: Common *questions* about Kursuok.lt
faqs.description: How the funding works, and what to do if you don't get it.

questions.question: What is Kursuok.lt?
questions.answer: It's a state-funded adult learning platform. Employed people can get up to €500 through it for a training program of their choice, and Unicamp's programs are among those funded.

questions.question: How much will a Unicamp program cost with Kursuok.lt funding?
questions.answer: A Unicamp program costs €500 and Kursuok.lt covers up to €500, so with funding you pay nothing for the course.

questions.question: When does registration open?
questions.answer: Kursuok.lt says the next call is expected no earlier than autumn 2026, with training starting tentatively in 2027. Save your spot and we'll let you know as soon as registration opens.

questions.question: Will you help me apply?
questions.answer: Yes. Once you save your spot, we'll email you when registration opens and, if you need it, help you fill in the Kursuok.lt application.

questions.question: Can I get funding if I'm not working right now?
questions.answer: Kursuok.lt funding is for people in employment. The Employment Service runs its own training funding programs, and you can also join a Unicamp program paying yourself.

questions.question: Can I take both programs?
questions.answer: The Kursuok.lt budget is up to €500, and one Unicamp program uses all of it. Once the full budget is used, you can only get funding again after 5 years, so you'd pay for a second program yourself.

questions.question: What if I don't get funding?
questions.answer: You can pay yourself: €500 in one payment, or €180 a month for three months. There's a 7-day money-back guarantee.

questions.question: Can I study while working?
questions.answer: Yes. Classes are online 2–3 evenings a week, 18:30–21:30, and every class is recorded, so you can catch up on one you miss.
